preload-tracker.title: Preload Status
preload-tracker.viewLogHint: Show per-asset load times for this preload run
preload-tracker.logNoRun: No preload run has been recorded yet.
preload-tracker.logNoAssets: No asset timings recorded for this user (they may not have finished loading).
preload-tracker.activateBtnTitle: Waiting for all connected users to finish preloading
preload-tracker.libwrapperReq: Preload Tracker: libWrapper is required. Enable it and reload.

settings.showToPlayersHint: When enabled, players will see the preload tracker window (without the Activate and Send to Chat buttons).
settings.skipAudioOnPreloadHint: When enabled, a scene's playlist audio is not preloaded (it still loads when the playlist plays). Use this when large loop tracks stall the scene preload.
settings.enableRaceModeHint: Show a race progress bar with rabbit/turtle icons and trophy placements when everyone finishes.
settings.debugLevelHint: Set the debug level for Preload Tracker.
settings.raceResultsScopeHint: Choose who is included in race placements.
